speakers.name: Dallin H. Oaks
speakers.current_title: President of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints (since October 2025)
roles: First Counselor in the First Presidency (2018–2025)
speakers.summary: Lawyer, law professor, and former BYU president; former Utah Supreme Court justice; became the Church's eighteenth president in October 2025.

speakers.name: Russell M. Nelson
speakers.current_title: Seventeenth President of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints (2018–2025)
roles: President of the Quorum of the Twelve (2015–2018)
speakers.summary: Pioneering heart surgeon who helped make open-heart surgery possible; apostle for over thirty years before leading the Church. Died September 27, 2025, at 101.

speakers.name: M. Russell Ballard
speakers.current_title: Acting President of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles (2018–2023)
roles: Acting President of the Quorum of the Twelve (2018–2023)
speakers.summary: Businessman in automotive, real estate, and investments before full-time Church service; called to the Seventy in 1976 and the Twelve in 1985. Died November 12, 2023.
